title: Bakushou!! All Yoshimoto Quiz-ou Ketteisen DX
native_title: 爆笑！！ オール吉本 クイズ王決定戦ＤＸ
overview:
Bakushou!! All Yoshimoto Quiz-ou Ketteisen DX is a quiz game starring a large cast of comedians and entertainers from Yoshimoto Kogyo, hosted by Shinsuke Shimada. Take your place on the studio panel and answer question after question to rack up the highest score in the quiz show mode. The Comical Fantasy Mode turns the quiz into an adventure: set off across a fantasy world to rescue a princess, using correct answers to slip past the monsters in your way while keeping an eye on your HP and MP.

- Quiz show mode and Comical Fantasy Mode
- 1 to 4 players
- Multi-terminal 6 (multitap) compatible
